summary: The branch and call match, but the condition is evaluated in the wrong order.
issues: The P-code evaluates (param_1 & 1) before storing to *self; the reversed code evaluates it afterward. This can change behavior if self aliases param_1.
The store at offset 0 uses a cast instead of a named struct member.
fix_instructions: Compute the condition into a local boolean before writing to *self, then branch on that boolean.
Define a struct with a named pointer member at offset 0 and use that member for the store.
